title: Area burned by forest fires by region, Canada, 1990 to 2024 (national total)
source: Canadian Council of Forest Ministers (2025), National Forestry Database (http://nfdp.ccfm.org/en/data/fires.php), via Environment and Climate Change Canada indicator
retrievalNote: Fetched with WebFetch (curl to canada.ca failed through the proxy); page table and CSV agree for 2003-2024; regional columns sum to the total within rounding.
notes: Includes fires of known and unknown origin. Nunavut excluded (not part of the data-sharing agreement).
